restaurantName: Linden Restaurant at Macdonald Frimley Hall Hotel & Spa
address: Macdonald Frimley Hall Hotel & Spa, Lime Avenue, Camberley,GU15 2BG
bio: Macdonald Frimley Hall is a luxurious Hotel and Spa nestled within the Camberley region and boasts a mouth-watering yet traditional approach to Afternoon Tea.  The sweeping grounds of the hotel are as grand and jaw-dropping a venue as they come, featuring luscious grounds  Enjoy a three tier Afternoon Tea comprised of traditional finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones with Devonshire clotted cream and strawberry preserve and assorted fresh fine pastries & cakes. Make it a truly special occasion by upgrading to a Champagne Afternoon Tea package for just an extra £10.  Camberley Rail Station is under a mile away, so why not have a leisurely stroll through the mesmering Surrey countryside before departing?
pageTitle: Linden Restaurant at Macdonald Frimley Hall Hotel & Spa
